title: Line sketch: Shadows Over the Kitchen Counter
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Two women in vintage attire occupy a mid-century kitchen dominated by a large overhead lamp, retro appliances, and a prominent television on the counter. The composition places the viewer across the island, with one figure leaning forward and the other standing alert amid framed wall pictures. Bold outlines and smooth tonal gradients define the monochromatic technique (derived from painting #151).
